name: Global Complement Counting
description: Replaces the local structural description of a triangle (three files shared among three workers) with a mathematically equivalent global property: a trio forms a deadlock if exactly m - 3 of the m total incident files involve at least one worker outside the trio. Models that literally translate this condition will write an O(n³m) algorithm and Time Out. Models must genuinely deduce that the complement condition implies the trio contains exactly 3 internal files (a triangle) to implement an efficient O(nm/64) or O(m√m) algorithm.
